resources.string: FXboard extras
Unofficial modified build: spacebar and navigation bar
Cursor and navigation bar
Drag spacebar up and down to change lines
Works alongside the normal left and right cursor drag. Only multi-line text fields respond.
Hide keyboard navigation bar
Removes the down arrow and keyboard switcher below the keys. Requires Android 15 or newer.
Ripple
A ring expands from where you touch
Key glow
The pressed key flashes and fades
Particles
A small burst of sparks on each press
Spacebar trail
A glowing trail follows your finger while dragging the cursor
FXboard is an unofficial, modified version of FUTO Keyboard. It is not made, endorsed or supported by FUTO. Please report issues with FXboard to github.com/Theo-Erickson/fxboard, not to FUTO.
Keyboard effects
Key pops, floating letters, swipe trails and more
